Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake:  
The first clear mistake was when WebSurfer followed the FedEx result page instead of actually obtaining the requested shipping rate. In the second WebSurfer turn, it clicked “Calculate Shipping Rates - FedEx,” but the page loaded as “page not found” and no usable rate was collected. This set the conversation off on a long loop of navigation attempts rather than producing the needed FedEx/DHL/USPS prices, which directly prevented reaching the correct cheapest-option JSON answer.
